scenicChapters.title: Cascade Lakes Scenic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 10 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

cascade-lakes-scenic-byway.story: A 97 km loop that starts and ends near Bend, about 1 h 34 of riding. It goes by way of Mount Bachelor, Elk Lake, Lava Lake and Sparks Lake. The highest point is about 1,650 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
